content_scope: Lemmas 1-3 and Theorem A: the translation-covariant Weyl family F_W is equivalent to unbiasedness to three Weyl eigenbases. Theorem B: automatic maximality of every solution. Theorem C: exactly two Clifford classes, B=(Z,X,XZ) and A=(Z,X,XZ^3), with the Legendre-symbol invariant. Import I1 (Grassl-McNulty-Mista-Paterek 2017, computer-aided): class B is strongly unextendible. Theorem D: Galois conjugacy of the complexified class A and B varieties. Corollary D1: conditional emptiness of class A. Corollary D2: abelian coordinates are excluded. Theorem E: C^5 plane reduction with odd-sum Lemma E1, H-pair Lemma E2, mixed-pair Lemma E3 and Dic3-symmetric exclusion E4. Section 9: exact class-A system with 18 real equations in 9 real unknowns.
exact_remaining_gap: Real solvability of class-A system (9.1). Equivalently: is there a vector in C^10 unbiased to the Z, X and XZ^3 eigenbases? A yes gives an explicit maximal 1-RQLS(10). A no closes the whole translation-covariant Weyl route. Unrestricted maximal 1-RQLS(10) remains UNKNOWN.
